name: Takahata Aoi
source:
The school idol who seen to be perfect in every way. He confesses to protag and see it like destiny to be together. Makes it his goal to get the protag to accept traps.

[spoiler]His father is principle and family owns the school. Was made as a safe haven for trap students. Comes from long line of family traditions of  traps marrying and get pregnant that this is common sense to him. Loves protag but hates to burden him. So much so that he tells him after getting pregnant he would raise his child as a single parent.[/spoiler]
